info.title: Vendor Dispatch Commerce Lifecycle Projection
info.description: Private, versioned Dispatch mission, stop and parcel evidence projected into Vendor orders and fulfilment.

post.summary: Project one authoritative Dispatch lifecycle event
post.description: The handler authenticates driver-dispatch-delivery-service with HMAC v2 and a persisted single-use nonce, validates source/schema/version/payload hash, resolves mission and parcel ownership from Vendor's own records, and ignores duplicate or stale versions.

payload.description: commerce.* retains its existing payload. Approved dispatch.* uses only source_ref, source_version, group_ref and missions[{mission_ref,version,state,parcel_refs}]. The source must match Vendor's reserved Dispatch operation; every parcel must belong to that operation. Additional fields/secrets are rejected. Exposed as dispatch_domain_projection on the existing authorized platform mission read model; never drives financial settlement.

400.description: Invalid envelope, payload or ownership evidence

413.description: Payload exceeds the bounded ingress size

503.description: Mission projection not committed yet; retry the same event

serviceHmacV2.name: X-Service-Signature
serviceHmacV2.description: HMAC v2 with X-Service-Name, timestamp and persisted single-use X-Service-Nonce.
